theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (u : Euclid n → Euclid k) (z : Euclid (n + k)) (s : ℝ), 0 < n → (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → 0 < s → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 s) → ∃ (ξ : Euclid (n + k) → MultiVector (n + k) n) (β : Euclid (n + k) → Covector (Euclid (n + k)) n), ContinuousOn ξ ((fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) '' ball (0 : Euclid n) s) ∧ ContinuousOn β ((fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) '' ball (0 : Euclid n) s) ∧ (∀ x ∈ (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) '' ball (0 : Euclid n) s, ξ x (β x) = 1) ∧ (∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) s, IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ (z + ι v + ι' (u v))) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) v : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)))) ∧ ∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) s, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid (n + k)) n, α (fun i => fderiv ℝ (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) v (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) = Real.sqrt (((fderiv ℝ (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) v).adjoint ∘L fderiv ℝ (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) v).det) * ξ (z + ι v + ι' (u v)) α
